verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents a GraphQL Developer API with introspection, a mutation-capable API playground, a 'Custom Integration Push APIs' reference section, and ingestion webhooks that let external systems send data directly into Sprinto. Together these give developers a documented way to push data from systems the catalog doesn't cover. However, the evidence never explicitly shows pushing evidence artifacts or control test results, and no downloadable OpenAPI or Postman spec exists (the probe returned 404s). missing for 10: explicit documentation of pushing evidence/test results into controls, payload schema examples for custom-integration push, downloadable API spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build private/custom integrations against a documented API to push evidence and test results from systems the catalog doesn't cover

citations.quote: Webhooks allow external systems to send data directly into Sprinto. Each webhook generates a unique endpoint URL that receives incoming requests from external services.
Receive incoming payloads, Trigger ingestion workflows, Process external events
The Sprinto Developer API is built using GraphQL and supports **introspection**.
You can use the playground to explore the API schema, test queries and mutations, and validate responses in real time.
